task.body:
## Problem
`climate_context_relevant` (`app/calyx_conversation/climate_context.py`) uses a plain substring test, so `rain` matches *train*, *drain* and *brain*, and `enso` matches *sensor*. Each false match triggers a live NOAA climate fetch: `"How do I train my orchid?"`, `"My pot does not drain well"` and `"Use a moisture sensor near the plant"` all return `True`.

## Required behaviour
- A term matches only when not preceded or followed by a word character: `(?<!\w)` + escaped term + `(?!\w)` on the already-normalised text.
- These return `False`: `"How do I train my orchid?"`, `"My pot does not drain well"`, `"Use a moisture sensor near the plant"`, `"The brain of the operation"`.
- These return `True`: `"Will it rain this winter?"`, `"What is the rainfall outlook?"`, `"Is ENSO active?"`, `"La Niña forecast"`, `"El Nino and orchids"`, `"Seasonal care tips"`.
- Nothing else changes.

## Scope
Allowed paths:
- `app/calyx_conversation/climate_context.py`
- `tests/test_climate_context_relevance.py`

Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above. `tests/test_climate_context_relevance.py` is a new file.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_climate_context_relevance.py tests/test_calyx_continuum_science_sources.py tests/test_calyx_speak_002.py`
- `python -m ruff check app/calyx_conversation/climate_context.py tests/test_climate_context_relevance.py`

New tests must cover:
- a parametrized True/False table with every message listed above.
